2. Application Topology Enumeration — mapping navigation trees, entry points, and static routes.
3. Configuration & Environment Auditing — inspecting cleartext configurations and debug variables.
4. Authentication Handling Review — auditing login workflows, form attributes, and transmission methods.
5. Client-Side Source Code Audit — line-by-line inspection of HTML schemas, DOM scripts, and metadata.
6. Input Validation Assessment — testing data sanitization across form controls and query variables.
7. Client-Side Injection (XSS) Testing — fuzzing presentation elements with script injection payloads.
8. Access Control Validation — verifying authorization barriers on administrative resources.
9. Known Vulnerability / CVE Correlation — checking identified version strings against vulnerability disclosures.
10. Evidence Collection & Forensic Screencaps — capturing DevTools network packets, DOM states, and responses.
11. Risk Analysis & Scoring — establishing CVSS v3.1 baselines for validated observations.
12. Remediation & Hardening Planning — formulating actionable technical mitigations.
1. Remove Static Credentials: immediately delete test-config.txt from web-accessible directories.

3. Enforce Ingestion Rules: configure .gitignore and CI/CD secret scanning rules to prevent credential commits.
1. Remove Unnecessary Directives: eliminate internal directory paths from robots.txt.
2. Server-Level Authorization: rely entirely on server-side authorization filters, IP whitelisting, or HTTP Basic
1. Strip Generator Tags: remove the <meta name="generator"> attribute from web templates.
2. Disable Client Debug Scripts: ensure build pipelines strip staging telemetry flags (debug=true) and internal
1. Explicit POST Method: define method="POST" on all authentication and sensitive input forms.
2. Enforce Transport Security: ensure the form submission target (action) binds strictly to an encrypted HTTPS URI
1. Server-Side Authentication: implement server-side middleware to ensure administrative endpoints require an
2. Navigation Obfuscation: restrict administrative navigation links from displaying to unauthenticated public users.
1. Apply Strict Input Types: change the email input to type="email" and enforce required and maxlength bounds.
2. Incorporate CSRF & Rate Limiting: enforce CSRF token validation and rate-limiting middleware on submission

2. Static Prototype Boundaries: several assets (admin.html, login.html, contact.html) functioned as client-side markup
